<style>
.qc-carousel {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 1rem 0 2rem 0;
  padding: 0 3.5rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.qc-carousel-window {
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: #fafafa;
}

.qc-carousel-track {
  display: flex;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.qc-carousel-slide {
  min-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.qc-carousel-slide img {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: 32rem;
  object-fit: contain;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.qc-carousel-caption {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #555;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.qc-carousel-button {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 2;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 2.5rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #2c3e50;
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.qc-carousel-button:hover {
  background: #1a252f;
}

.qc-carousel-button.previous {
  left: 0.25rem;
}

.qc-carousel-button.next {
  right: 0.25rem;
}

.qc-carousel-counter {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  color: #666;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
</style>

<script>
function qcCarouselMove(carouselId, direction) {
  const carousel = document.getElementById(carouselId);

  if (!carousel) {
    return;
  }

  const track = carousel.querySelector(".qc-carousel-track");
  const slides = carousel.querySelectorAll(".qc-carousel-slide");
  const counter = carousel.querySelector(".qc-carousel-counter");

  if (slides.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = Number(carousel.dataset.currentIndex || 0);

  currentIndex = currentIndex + direction;

  if (currentIndex < 0) {
    currentIndex = slides.length - 1;
  }

  if (currentIndex >= slides.length) {
    currentIndex = 0;
  }

  carousel.dataset.currentIndex = currentIndex;
  track.style.transform = "translateX(-" + (currentIndex * 100) + "%)";
  counter.textContent = (currentIndex + 1) + " / " + slides.length;
}
</script>

```{r}
find_images <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) {
    return(character())
  }

  sort(
    list.files(
      path = path,
      pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png)$",
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )
}

read_csv_if_exists <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  readr::read_csv(
    file = path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

## Helper for tibble reading
summary_value <- function(data, column, default = "Unavailable") {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !column %in% names(data) ||
      is.na(data[[column]][[1]])
  ) {
    return(default)
  }

  as.character(data[[column]][[1]])
}

# Status-summary helpers

count_status <- function(data, status) {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !"status" %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(0L)
  }

  sum(
    data$status == status,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

has_compensaid_flags <- function(data) {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !"flagged_pairs" %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  flagged_pairs <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(data$flagged_pairs)
  )

  any(
    flagged_pairs > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


# HTML carousel helper

make_image_carousel <- function(
  image_files,
  carousel_id,
  title = NULL,
  image_height = "32rem"
) {
  image_files <- image_files[
    file.exists(image_files)
  ]

  if (length(image_files) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::HTML(
        "<p>No images were found for this section.</p>"
      )
    )
  }

  image_files <- normalizePath(
    image_files,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )

  image_sources <- fs::path_rel(
    image_files,
    start = project_root
  )

  image_sources <- gsub(
    "\\\\",
    "/",
    image_sources
  )

  escape_html <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("\"", "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
  }

  slides <- purrr::map2_chr(
    image_sources,
    basename(image_files),
    function(image_source, image_label) {
      paste0(
        '<div class="qc-carousel-slide">',
        '<img src="',
        escape_html(image_source),
        '" alt="',
        escape_html(image_label),
        '" style="height:',
        image_height,
        ';">',
        '<div class="qc-carousel-caption">',
        escape_html(image_label),
        "</div>",
        "</div>"
      )
    }
  )

  title_html <- if (is.null(title)) {
    ""
  } else {
    paste0(
      "<h4>",
      escape_html(title),
      "</h4>"
    )
  }

  html <- paste0(
    '<div class="qc-carousel" id="',
    escape_html(carousel_id),
    '">',

    title_html,

    '<button class="qc-carousel-button previous" ',
    'type="button" aria-label="Previous image" ',
    'onclick="qcCarouselMove(\'',
    escape_html(carousel_id),
    '\', -1)">',
    "&#10094;",
    "</button>",

    '<div class="qc-carousel-window">',
    '<div class="qc-carousel-track">',
    paste(slides, collapse = ""),
    "</div>",
    "</div>",

    '<button class="qc-carousel-button next" ',
    'type="button" aria-label="Next image" ',
    'onclick="qcCarouselMove(\'',
    escape_html(carousel_id),
    '\', 1)">',
    "&#10095;",
    "</button>",

    '<div class="qc-carousel-counter">',
    "1 / ",
    length(slides),
    "</div>",

    "</div>"
  )

  htmltools::HTML(html)
}

message("QC report setup: completed")
flush.console()
```

# Executive summary

```{r}
#| label: executive-summary

pipeline_status <- summary_value(
  pipeline_summary,
  "pipeline_status",
  default = NA_character_
)

generated_image_count <- sum(
  c(
    length(variant_images),
    length(autofluorescence_images),
    length(scatter_images),
    length(similarity_images),
    length(spectra_images),
    length(clean_control_images),
    length(patient_gating_images),
    length(controls_gating_images),
    length(patient_compensaid_images),
    length(controls_compensaid_images)
  )
)

loaded_table_count <- sum(
  !vapply(
    list(
      pipeline_summary,
      af_status,
      patient_unmixing_status,
      nonpatient_unmixing_status,
      patient_compensaid_summary,
      controls_compensaid_summary,
      qc_export_status
    ),
    is.null,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
)

if (is.na(pipeline_status)) {
  cat(
    "⚠️ Pipeline summary was not found. ",
    "The report may be rendering before the pipeline has completed."
  )
} else if (identical(pipeline_status, "completed")) {
  cat(
    "✅ The analysis pipeline completed successfully. ",
    "Found ",
    generated_image_count,
    " diagnostic image(s) and ",
    loaded_table_count,
    " summary/status table(s).",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "❌ The analysis pipeline did not complete successfully. ",
    "Recorded status: ",
    pipeline_status,
    ". Found ",
    generated_image_count,
    " diagnostic image(s) and ",
    loaded_table_count,
    " summary/status table(s).",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

# Pipeline status

## Status summary

```{r}
#| label: status-summary

af_has_flags <- function(data) {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !"af_status" %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  any(
    data$af_status == "flagged",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

status_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Stage = c(
    "Patient AF extraction",
    "Patient unmixing",
    "Nonpatient unmixing",
    "Gating",
    "Patient compensAID",
    "Control compensAID"
  ),
  Status = c(
    if (is.null(af_status)) {
      "Unavailable"
    } else if (af_has_flags(af_status)) {
      "⚠️ Review"
    } else {
      "✅ No flags"
    },

    if (is.null(patient_unmixing_status)) {
      "Unavailable"
    } else if (
      count_status(patient_unmixing_status, "flagged") > 0 ||
        count_status(patient_unmixing_status, "failed") > 0
    ) {
      "⚠️ Review"
    } else {
      "✅ No flags"
    },

    if (is.null(nonpatient_unmixing_status)) {
      "Unavailable"
    } else if (count_status(nonpatient_unmixing_status, "failed") > 0) {
      "⚠️ Review"
    } else {
      "✅ No failures"
    },

    if (
      length(patient_gating_images) == 0 &&
        length(controls_gating_images) == 0
    ) {
      "Unavailable"
    } else {
      "✅ Results available"
    },

    if (
      is.null(patient_compensaid_summary) &&
        length(patient_compensaid_images) == 0
    ) {
      "Unavailable"
    } else if (has_compensaid_flags(patient_compensaid_summary)) {
      "⚠️ Review"
    } else {
      "✅ No flagged pairs"
    },

    if (
      is.null(controls_compensaid_summary) &&
        length(controls_compensaid_images) == 0
    ) {
      "Unavailable"
    } else if (has_compensaid_flags(controls_compensaid_summary)) {
      "⚠️ Review"
    } else {
      "✅ No flagged pairs"
    }
  )
)

knitr::kable(status_summary)
```

# Gating QC

```{r}
#| label: gating-availability

if (
  length(patient_gating_images) == 0 &&
    length(controls_gating_images) == 0
) {
  cat(
    "⚠️ Gating images were not found. Expected folders: ",
    patient_gating_folder,
    " and ",
    controls_gating_folder
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "✅ Gating results are available. ",
    length(patient_gating_images),
    " patient image(s) and ",
    length(controls_gating_images),

  )
}
```

# compensAID QC

## Patient summary

```{r}
#| label: patient-compensaid-summary

if (
  is.null(patient_compensaid_summary) &&
    length(patient_compensaid_images) == 0
) {
  cat(
    "Patient compensAID results are unavailable. ",
    "No summary table or diagnostic images were found."
  )
} else if (is.null(patient_compensaid_summary)) {
  cat(
    "Patient compensAID summary table is unavailable. ",
    length(patient_compensaid_images),
    " diagnostic image(s) are available for review."
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(patient_compensaid_summary)
}
```

## Patient flagged pairs

```{r}
#| label: patient-compensaid-flags
#| results: asis

patient_compensaid_matrix_images <- patient_compensaid_images[
  grepl(
    "_SSI_matrix",
    basename(patient_compensaid_images),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(patient_compensaid_matrix_images) == 0) {
  cat("No patient compensAID SSI matrix images were found.")
} else {
  cat(
    make_image_carousel(
      image_files = patient_compensaid_matrix_images,
      carousel_id = "patient-compensaid-ssi-matrices",
      title = "Patient compensAID SSI matrices",
      image_height = "32rem"
    )
  )
}

patient_compensaid_pair_images <- patient_compensaid_images[
  grepl(
    "_pair_",
    basename(patient_compensaid_images),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

if (is.null(patient_compensaid_summary)) {
  cat(
    "Patient compensAID summary is unavailable."
  )
} else if (!has_compensaid_flags(patient_compensaid_summary)) {
  cat("✅ No patient samples contain flagged SSI pairs.")
} else if (length(patient_compensaid_pair_images) == 0) {
  cat(
    "⚠️ Patient samples contain flagged SSI pairs, but no pair-review images ",
    "were found."
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "⚠️ Patient samples contain flagged SSI pairs. ",
    "Review the diagnostic pair plots below.\n\n"
  )

  cat(
    make_image_carousel(
      image_files = patient_compensaid_pair_images,
      carousel_id = "patient-compensaid-flagged-pairs",
      title = "Patient compensAID flagged-pair diagnostics",
      image_height = "32rem"
    )
  )
}
```

# Review checklist

Use this checklist during review:

- [ ] Pipeline completed without a fatal error.
- [ ] All expected patient samples are present in the input inventory.
- [ ] Patient unstained samples are available for the intended patient samples.
- [ ] AF extraction flags have been reviewed.
- [ ] Patient unmixing flags and failures have been reviewed.
- [ ] Nonpatient unmixing failures have been reviewed.
- [ ] Patient cleanup gates appear appropriate.
- [ ] Control cleanup gates appear appropriate.
- [ ] Event populations are plausible after cleanup gating.
- [ ] compensAID flagged pairs have been reviewed.
